integrity: An elementary exact proof is accompanied by exhaustive BFS and formula checks on 87,360 vertex subsets through n=8, plus finite algebra checks through n=50; computations do not independently certify arbitrary n.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats canonical half graphs with one vertex per nested-neighborhood level, not every chain graph or every visibility variant. Earlier work already gives the maximum-cardinality/uniqueness fact; the all-cardinality polynomial and its total count are the asserted new contribution. An unindexed equivalent enumerator remains possible.
title: Complete mutual-visibility polynomial of half graphs
